description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a 'Track Order' screen in a shopping app. It includes UI layout, design tokens, status timeline, map illustration area, and navigation controls.

classes.name: TrackOrderScreen
classes.description: Main widget for the 'Track Order' UI, composed of a scaffold with various UI components describing order status, map, ETA, and actions.

classes.name: _Badge
classes.description: A small circular badge widget displaying a number, used for notifications/badge count.

classes.name: _StatusRow
classes.description: Represents a single row in the order status timeline, with dynamic styling based on status.

classes.name: _TimelineConnector
classes.description: Draws a vertical connector line between status dots in the timeline.

classes.name: _VehicleMarker
classes.description: Simulation of vehicle icon for map illustration.

classes.name: _DestinationPin
classes.description: Simulation of destination pin icon for map illustration.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the entire widget tree for the 'Track Order' screen.

methods.name: onTap
methods.description: Handles tapping the back button, navigating to the previous screen.

methods.name: onPressed
methods.description: Handles 'Back to Home' button press, navigating back to the root.
